description:
The user's own CapitalSnitch account: plan (Free / Scout / Analyst / Edge), whether it is active, renewing,
cancelled or expired, the date it renews or ends and days left, payment method type, questions used today vs
the daily limit, which features are included and which need an upgrade. Free to call (does not count toward the
daily limit). Use when the user asks 'what plan am I on?', 'when does my subscription renew?', 'is my plan
active?', 'how many questions do I have left?'. The user is recognized by their personal connection address —
no email or password is needed.
